rawContent: If you’re into #crimefiction & would  like to know more about our Founder @winniemli ‘s next novel #Complicit she’s giving a #free preview at the famed #TheakstonsCrime @HarrogateFest on July 23rd! An intriguing, unique take on #MeToo & gender inequality in the film industry

We’re so glad Winnie was able to share our creative writing exercise by @ShareClaw as a way to round off today’s important panel about survivorhood, trauma & the film industry at #WWAMC 🙏 we hope it brought a moment of connection & hope to those who participated 🌟#MeToo

If you'd like to access more creative writing exercises for survivors of trauma & sexual assault, our entire guide by @ShareClaw is FREE to download here. Please share widely! ✍️ #WWAMC #MeToo #endVAWG https://t.co/czMb6yHV3A

Our Founder @winniemli gave a cracking preview of her next novel #Complicit at @HarrogateFest over the weekend 🔥🔥 It’ll become available to pre-order at 2pm TODAY!!! 👇👇👇 #MeToo #StrongerTogether #BreakTheSilence

That’s a brilliant cover - and the book itself is even more 🔥🔥🔥 Look out for #Complicit the next novel from our founder (& tireless activist-survivor-researcher @winniemli ) - It’ll make you re-think what you know about #MeToo  - Available to pre-order now!
